units.applied: signed motor-polarity PWM permille; not measured current or torque
units.internal_extra_fields: legacy internal coordinates retained for per-build replay with the correct source, hidden states and causal input history

logical_u.meaning: actual committed logical command at the sample instant; never pending_command
logical_u.automatic: A result computed from frame n measurements is queued and submitted at frame n+1 tick, together with its limit. STOP, disarm and faults can force zero immediately. The first frame of a new session has no old pending result.
logical_u.manual_local_capture: Existing observer transaction-completion submission is retained; no fixed-frame pending stage. Checkpoint-seeded manual observer replay is supported only with all active hidden-state prerequisites satisfied; R36 automatic-only fast/platform gates are bypassed for manual capture.
logical_u.previous_duty: Control models read the actual committed controller.command, never an uncommitted pending result.
logical_u.zero_output_reacquisition: State7 COAST clears committed and pending logical PWM and disables output. It is an active armed session, not successful holding.32 consecutive actual non-gap samples may resume automatic swing;600ms timeout and cumulative12s budget remain.
logical_u.seamless_ext2: Session policy is retained: automatic sessions use previous-interval applied command in prediction and next-frame output commit; manual sessions keep transaction-completion commit. Entry/exit does not ARM/CAPTURE/reset origin or ordinary configuration.

record_timing.passive_trigger: controller.result_valid (computation done); passive_capture registers the write bundle before RAM write
record_timing.passive_contents: Measurements for the current calculation and command/limit already committed at that instant. In automatic sessions this command normally came from the previous frame calculation.
record_timing.telemetry: 50 Hz snapshot derived from result_valid; u is the logical command at snapshot, not a newly calculated pending result.
record_timing.cache_scope: C831 176-bit x8192 actual1ms samples: fixed head4096 plus rolling tail4096. START/CAPTURE explicitly begin a session; STOP/fault freezes. Capacity does not STOP or freeze a normal full run: tail slots continue rolling. Longer runs have an explicit timestamp gap between head and tail, never interpolated into continuous1kHz. Full-session50Hz run/raw_RX continue.
record_timing.observer_checkpoint: Same50Hz64byte observer format also emitted in automatic BRAKE(state6), including before formal capture. It contains the legacy seven z states, integral/LP/age/anchor and does not contain all R35/R36 new hidden state. State must be aligned by tick with full telemetry; observer age is not a success flag. Existing async UART queue does not delay control. R39 explicit Extension2 adds type9/10 companions at25Hz, atomically cohort-locked with type4; C101 type6 and C831 type7/8 retain meanings. CP-b flags explicitly retain samples/ready/fault;20-field restore requires all three frames.
record_timing.brake_reference: In BRAKE, exported reference is the legacy fallback swing_ref. Mature observer uses current phi as provisional arm reference relative to its fixed anchor. During blend these are distinct; do not score BRAKE position error as settled tracking. On confirmed capture the current arm point becomes fixed target. State/tick/phi plus observer checkpoint reconstruct this distinction.
record_timing.raw_theta: C831 records actual estimator theta Q16 and dtheta Q16; no filtered_theta field is present. Do not substitute filtered_theta_q18>>2 or fill a zero filtered column.
record_timing.r40_replay_scope: C831/ordinary/CP retain recorded meanings. Debug word15 low8 holds profile transfer_ticks, bit8 holds ordinary r40_unwind_active; remaining bits must be zero. This observer CP still omits centered-reference center/exit envelope and other ordinary hidden state. Exact whole-R40 restart requires snapshot_seamless_state v2 plus complete controller/reference state and causal history. Reject old v1 snapshots for v2; do not fill missing fields with zero or claim full snapshot equivalence from CP alone.

applied_driver.latch_rule: motor_pwm latches bounded safe_drive multiplied by motor_sign at the carrier boundary; disable clears applied immediately on a clock edge.
applied_driver.reversal_rule: Opposite polarity first causes one complete carrier period of zero output.
applied_driver.relationship: applied is the registered carrier-latched drive after guard, sign mapping and reversal coast. It is not universally equal to -u in the same row or the previous row.
applied_driver.tail_equality_audit: not available from 1 kHz samples alone: carrier phase, enable changes and intervening command transitions are not recorded at 50 MHz. No guessed row-shift check is reported as a failure or PASS.

identity_scope: Only board build 4A070257. This describes source semantics and does not itself authorize motion or prove the full board bitstream.

coordinates.live: type5: phi physical Q16; dphi/reference/ref_velocity/target legacy internal Q16, converted once by host
coordinates.passive: C831 raw type7/type8 carry176-bit actual samples, with phi derived once from encoder count and same-session encoder_zero by C101. Schema records derived-source attribution. Legacy type3/352-bit and D02 records are read-only compatible, not rewritten into fake raw fields.
coordinates.observer: type4 z/integral/origin remain legacy_internal; never relabel as physical
coordinates.target: opcode0x26 accepts physical Q16; board maps to internal; legacy opcode0x06 rejected
coordinates.motion_config: opcode0x36 original legacy packed bins; UI shows physical applied values; old opcode0x16 rejected
coordinates.numeric_motion_speed: opcode0x37 accepts physical positive rad/s Q16 (GUI1..60physical deg/s). calibrated_command converts once with J280_C_TARGET_K_Q24 into legacy internal rad/s Q16; controller passes motion_speed_limit<<<2 as Q18 to reference. Descriptor type6 bytes52..55 return the internal Q16 limit; bytes56..59 tag0x3601 identifies these fields. Applying opcode0x36 clears this numeric limit to zero and restores the original discrete-speed path, so the GUI prepares config then speed then INFO/readback.
coordinates.arm: new calibration contract token; old ARM token rejected
coordinates.saturation: flags bit15: exported physical Q16 overflow; host blocks further motion commands; STOP remains available
coordinates.old_logs: type1/build2F remain legacy_original; no automatic rewrite or calibration of old files

r35_state_replay.scope: Inherited R35/4A070237 state semantics; retained as historical provenance and still required where these paths remain active in R36. R36 additions are specified separately below.
r35_state_replay.observer_new_unrecorded_state: Actual-encoder/reference stasis last_error32 and count8; legacy observer checkpoint fields unchanged. Establish201ms causal real input history or session reset before claiming exact affected gate replay.
r35_state_replay.controller_new_unrecorded_state: Completed-guard active history, once-per-capture yield used, and real recaptured-default-home history. Sparse50Hz flags do not encode every1ms state.
r35_state_replay.default_local_home: No explicit target/shuttle only; report displacement from original capture separately from new local tracking error. Explicit commands retain original targets.

r36_state_replay.fast_good_count: r36_fast_good is an8-bit saturating201 count of consecutive eligible accepted observer transactions. Qualification requires mature static automatic HOLD, no BRAKE, zero reference velocity, no latched motion or explicit motion-assist permission, current actual non-gap measurement and finite in-range measured_omega(+/-30rad/s). An ineligible accepted transaction resets the count; clear/reset resets count and transaction latches.
r36_state_replay.transaction_snapshot: At accepted start&&!busy&&!fault, latch r36_omega_s=measured_omega(Q16)<<8 to Q24 and r36_fast_enabled_s=eligible&&(previous fast_good>=1). Thus the second consecutive qualified transaction may use the rate correction. Live input changes during busy do not replace the accepted transaction snapshot.
r36_state_replay.rate_correction: Use the latched measured dtheta minus10*n1, where n1 is the updated observer normalized omega/10 state. Apply an engineering dead zone of0.8rad/s(Q24=13421773), retain only the excess with sign, divide by16 and clamp to+/-1048576 Q24, equivalent to+/-62.5 logical PWM permille before the retained downstream limits/slew. Measured dtheta is the estimator's current measurement-based estimate, not an independent true angular-speed sensor.
r36_state_replay.platform_feedback_limit: Only while the inherited real same-encoder/reference stasis integral gate is true and fast_good>=201, clamp the velocity used for arm-velocity feedback and friction lookup to+/-50332 normalized(v/10)Q24, about+/-0.03 legacy rad/s. Do not clamp or reset z0..z6/n0..n6, replace sensor data, or assert that actual instantaneous velocity is bounded by this value.
r36_state_replay.checkpoint_limit: Legacy checkpoint packets do not carry fast_good, fast_enabled_s, omega_s, R35 stasis history or every controller guard/reference state. Reconstruct them from the same-build true continuous1kHz inputs and a verified reset/session start, or causally establish the necessary eligibility/stasis history before the replay window. Do not initialize missing state arbitrarily, interpolate50Hz inputs, or claim exact arbitrary-tail replay from one checkpoint alone.
r36_state_replay.legal_reference_continuity: Within the existing actual auto_observer_warm gate, tracking_initialized&&!pre_capture&&automatic_goal!=0 keeps automatic_hold true during legal goal1/2/3 reference motion. The old uninitialized/static hold paths remain. This is base observer continuity, not a new motion-assist grant or target-acceptance override: explicit goal1 and active goal2 waveform retain their original motion-assist schedule. Invalid measurement/domain, COAST, guard reblend, STOP, disarm and clear retain their original cancellation/clear behavior.
r36_state_replay.motion_stage_cap: The original automatic motion_latched progression now advances only while motion_phase<3, automatic, non-BRAKE and observer age>=200, once per50 completed eligible transactions. It no longer advances to stages4..7. This is not an automatic reset policy: motion_latched, motion_phase, motion_watch and related history retain their original clear/reset lifetime and do not return to zero merely because the reference stops or a target arrives. An inherited artificial phase>=3 snapshot is not silently clipped by this rule. Exact replay needs the actual same-build reset/history.
r36_state_replay.motion_bypass_scope: The sticky motion_latched state continues to bypass the R36 fast-current-measurement and platform-limiting gates, as well as inherited gates that explicitly require !motion_latched. Therefore a post-motion stationary sample is not automatically equivalent to mature never-moved HOLD, even when reference_velocity is zero. No automatic unlatch, observer-state reset or new re-entry policy has been added. Report the applicable gate and hidden-state history instead of resetting missing state to obtain a desired result.
r36_state_replay.reference_ready: Telemetry flag bit7 follows controller.reference_ready: HOLD/TRACK, tracking initialized, reference stationary, no pending shuttle, and either no pending target or a quiet-gated internal return that has not begun moving(!automatic_quiet). An explicit command may replace that internal wait. An active moving reference, explicit pending target or pending shuttle remains busy. Reference-ready and reference-arrival are not proof of actual measured position arrival.

r36_session_and_review.duration: GUI defaults START/CAPTURE seconds=0: operator STOP without software total-duration timeout. Optional user timing remains available. The old controller120s total-session fault is removed and its17-bit session counter saturates instead of wrapping. Per-recovery swing timeout, measurement/control watchdog, output limits, finite cable/workspace limits, STOP and SW4 remain active.
r36_session_and_review.communication_watchdog: Once armed, only a CRC-valid host-to-board INFO opcode0x30 refreshes the independent3000ms link watchdog. Host worker emits explicit INFO about every300ms even when unsolicited board INFO keeps arriving. Expiry enters the existing STOP/cancellation path; reconnect/INFO does not re-arm or restart motion.
r36_session_and_review.capture_timing: In an automatic session, first entry into CAPTURE(state2) follows the unchanged30ms/observer-ready confirmation and is the capture-confirmation event. HOLD(state3) follows a further2s capture-settling interval; using HOLD alone adds2s incorrectly. First-startup time begins at that START ACK; exit-to-recapture uses the actual exit of a captured state. Also report disturbance-to-recapture separately when the disturbance time is known. Never borrow a later START success across STOP/clear boundaries.
r36_session_and_review.timing_resolution: Ordinary telemetry is about50Hz and its confirmation times carry sampling uncertainty. Only the actual continuous1kHz cached windows support1ms input/history reconstruction. Operator manual STOP is a valid end condition; no fixed30s duration or fixed15degree target is required for review.

r36_evidence.scope: Read the final source-bound receipt and its limitations. Local resource estimates are not accepted Gowin STA, and component/closed-loop model results are not a physical three-second/no-oscillation guarantee. Historical receipts retain their own source and applicability.

extension2.config: Ordinary configuration and numeric speed are retained; no fixed config write during entry/exit.
extension2.entry: Same automatic or manual captured session. Explicit opcode0x38 value1 starts after existing HOLD/TRACK and reference-ready admission; capture or position in progress may queue in host. No STOP/config swap/recapture or extra stillness window.
extension2.board_window: No test-duration timer or one-activation-per-capture limit. value0 requests2s smooth exit, then ordinary target or reentry is allowed. STOP/disarm/fault/recovery clear the active mode; no stale automatic restart.
extension2.observer_units: legacy internal Q24; never apply public coordinate conversion
extension2.host_operation: One apply/start button writes amplitude and phase step, confirms board echo, exits ordinary shuttle if needed, then enters sine. Edit while running: smooth exit, new parameter echo, smooth reentry without STOP/recapture. Exit button returns to ordinary hold.
extension2.center: Entry reference position plus/minus operator-configured amplitude; 2s quintic entry/exit. Mechanical workspace checked, no measured-stillness or arrived gate.
extension2.session_policy: Automatic session retains next-frame commit; manual capture retains transaction-completion commit. Shared observer/MAC/reference, no second parallel control engine.
extension2.performance: R41 active-sine feedback retained; existing position feedforward is scaled by (3.5 / configured_period)^2 using the shared reference serial multiplier. Exact coefficient1 at legacy3.5s. Current hard cap overrides any conflicting previous-output slew interval. Model results are not physical guarantees.

period_command.unit: unsigned phase increment per 1ms, 2^32 per turn

extension2.checkpoint_sine_reference: Frequency-weighted relative reference in internal Q24, not the unweighted target angle.

r40_control_changes.position_unwind: Explicit automatic motion permission and current real measurement, non-BRAKE/non-A only. Opposed LP exceeds1218492 Q24 and |I|>=838861 starts a retained lease. While valid scope and I nonzero, same-sign LP pauses actual release without clearing the lease. Opposed LP resumes below the initial trigger. Step coefficient8389 with +/-16777 per tick; never cross zero through this release. Clear, fault, scope removal or A revoke. CP bit8 records the lease, not whether this particular tick releases.
r40_control_changes.ordinary_hold_narrow_ramp: Only without explicit motion-assist permission, retained strong residual transition rises continuously from0.8 to0.83125rad/s. Explicit position motion and subsequent endpoint holding retain the original R38 strong correction; the narrow ramp is not applied to that domain. Same strong correction outside the short ramp.
r40_control_changes.swing_progress: Limited envelope relaxation uses latest valid turning-amplitude cos(theta) progress, existing stagnation and current valid measurement. Ordinary gap disables current action and clears current coupling phase, while latest real gain/eligible may persist; COAST/exit SWING clears eligibility. Unchanged cumulative12s budget, hard35% output, hard workspace and STOP.
r40_control_changes.scope: These source changes and simulations do not certify physical damping, exact endpoint arrival or new vendor timing.
